title: Confinement and catalysis in designed peptide barrels
question: How do peptide design and assay conditions relate to measured assembly or functional response?
publisher: Zenodo; originating researchers: Petrenas, Rokas (University of Bristol); Oliver, Thomas A.A. (University of Bristol); Woolfson, Derek N. (University of Bristol)
measurement_dates: Public release 2025-01-11; precise measurement times must be obtained per instrument acquisition header and are not asserted for the whole study.
variables_and_units: Variables and units are preserved in native column headers, instrument metadata and source dictionaries; see evidence anchors below.
validation_design: Peptide/construct and independent experiment. Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.

prior_analysis_and_limits: The data support Confinement and Catalysis Within De Novo Designed Peptide Barrels. This selection is a complete source main-data package, not the complete record; excluded supplementary data may be needed for particular supporting claims. Source experimental package plus molecular/computational context; distinguish simulation results from laboratory measurements.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
